text: まえに　かかれた　レポートに　うえから　かいても　いいですか？

structure.jp: まえに　かかれた　レポートに
うえから　かいても　いいですか？
structure.en: is it OK to write over it?

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: かいても　いいですか
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus もいい asks or says that doing something is OK. かいても　いいですか = 'is it OK to write?'

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the thing was done to something, without saying who did it. かかれた = 'was written'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まえに　かかれた　レポート
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. まえに　かかれた　レポート = 'the report that was written before'.
